_note: 學習路徑內容建置第5批 #2／6：過去簡單式不規則動詞（eng.t_mid.verb.past-simple-irregular，會考級／中階）。不規則動詞過去式不加 -ed、要變形（go→went、eat→ate、see→saw、take→took、buy→bought、give→gave）；每個主詞過去式同形、不加 -s；否定/疑問用 did/didn't ＋ 原形（動詞回原形）。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix pir_）。

units.can_do: 我能把常見不規則動詞變成正確的過去式（go→went、eat→ate、see→saw、take→took、buy→bought、give→gave），知道過去式每個主詞同形、不加 -s，也知道否定和疑問句用 did/didn't ＋ 原形（動詞要變回原形）。
units.situation_group: 動詞時態 Past simple (irregular verbs)
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Irregular verbs form the past simple by changing their spelling, not by adding -ed: go->went, eat->ate, see->saw, take->took, buy->bought.
claims.verification_ref: 不規則動詞過去式變形、不加 -ed；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The past simple form is the same for every subject (I/you/he/she/we/they went); there is no extra -s for he/she/it in the past.
claims.verification_ref: 過去式每個主詞同形、不加 -s；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In negatives and questions we use did/didn't + the base verb, so the main verb goes back to its base form: Did you see it? I didn't go. (not 'Did you saw', not 'didn't went')
claims.verification_ref: 否定/疑問用 did/didn't＋原形；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Some very common irregular past forms to remember: have->had, make->made, come->came, get->got, give->gave, write->wrote.
claims.verification_ref: 常見不規則過去式；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Most verbs add -ed in the past, but irregular verbs change their whole form and do not add -ed: go -> went, eat -> ate, see -> saw, take -> took, buy -> bought. You have to learn these one by one.
teach.zh_hint: 多數動詞過去式加 -ed，但「不規則動詞」要整個變形、不加 -ed：go➜went、eat➜ate、see➜saw、take➜took、buy➜bought。這些只能一個個記起來。

teach.body: Yesterday I went to the zoo and saw a tiger.
teach.zh_hint: 昨天我去了動物園，看到一隻老虎。go➜went、see➜saw。

teach.body: Good news: in the past simple, every subject uses the same form. He/she/it does not add -s (I went, she went, they went are all the same).
teach.zh_hint: 好消息：過去式每個主詞都用同一個形式，he／she／it 也不加 -s（I went、she went、they went 都一樣）。

teach.body: She ate breakfast and then took the bus to work.
teach.zh_hint: 她吃了早餐，然後搭公車去上班。eat➜ate、take➜took，主詞是 She 也不加 -s。

teach.body: For negatives and questions, use did/didn't, and then the main verb goes back to the base form (not the past form): I didn't go (not didn't went), Did you see? (not Did you saw).
teach.zh_hint: 否定句和疑問句用 did／didn't，這時主要動詞要變回原形（不是過去式）：I didn't go（不是 didn't went）、Did you see?（不是 Did you saw）。

teach.body: I didn't buy the book. Did you see my keys?
teach.zh_hint: 我沒買那本書。你有看到我的鑰匙嗎？didn't／Did 後面用原形 buy／see。

practice.stem: 填入正確的過去式：Last weekend we ____ to the beach.（上週末我們去了海邊。）

distractor_rationales.goed: go 是不規則動詞，過去式不是 goed，而是 went。
distractor_rationales.go: go 是原形（現在式）；這裡是 last weekend（過去），要用 went。
distractor_rationales.gone: gone 是過去分詞，要搭配 have（have gone）；單獨的過去式是 went。

practice.feedback: go 的過去式是 went（不規則，不加 -ed）：we went to the beach。

practice.stem: 填入正確的過去式：She ____ a big breakfast this morning.（她今天早上吃了豐盛的早餐。）

distractor_rationales.eated: eat 是不規則動詞，過去式不是 eated，而是 ate。
distractor_rationales.eat: eat 是原形；this morning 已過，要用過去式 ate。
distractor_rationales.eaten: eaten 是過去分詞，要搭配 have（has eaten）；單獨的過去式是 ate。

practice.feedback: eat 的過去式是 ate：She ate a big breakfast。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：I ____ go to school yesterday because I was sick.（我昨天沒去上學，因為我生病了。）

distractor_rationales.don't: don't 是現在式；yesterday 是過去，否定要用 didn't。
distractor_rationales.wasn't: wasn't 後面不接原形動詞 go；否定一般動詞要用 didn't go。
distractor_rationales.didn't went: didn't 後面要用原形 go，不是過去式 went。

practice.feedback: 過去否定用 didn't ＋ 原形：I didn't go to school yesterday。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：____ you buy anything at the store?（你在店裡有買任何東西嗎？）

distractor_rationales.Do: Do 是現在式；問過去的事要用 Did you buy…?。
distractor_rationales.Were: Were 後面不接原形 buy；問一般動詞的過去事要用 Did。
distractor_rationales.Was: Was 是單數 be 動詞，也不接原形 buy；要用 Did you buy…?。

practice.feedback: 過去疑問用 Did ＋ 原形：Did you buy anything…?。

practice.stem: 填入正確的過去式：He ____ me a birthday present last week.（他上週送了我一個生日禮物。）

distractor_rationales.gived: give 是不規則動詞，過去式不是 gived，而是 gave。
distractor_rationales.give: give 是原形；last week 已過，要用 gave。
distractor_rationales.given: given 是過去分詞，要搭配 have（has given）；單獨的過去式是 gave。

practice.feedback: give 的過去式是 gave：He gave me a birthday present。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: We went to the night market last night and ate a lot of delicious food.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：went（go 的過去式）和 ate（eat 的過去式）有沒有拼對，句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。注意過去式字的發音（went、ate、saw）；兩句句尾自然下收。

lines.text: I saw a great movie yesterday.
lines.intonation: 平穩、saw 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: We ate dinner and went home early.
lines.intonation: 平穩、ate／went 稍強調、句尾下收
